title: CycleGateEvent
description: A development-flow stage gate transition aep-api routes to the cycle workflow (devflow:<org>:<project>:<cycle>) as an Approve/Revise/Back/MarkComplete signal. Carries who/what for audit.

mode.description: Whether a person or an automated gate produced this transition.

actor.description: User id (human mode) or the automated gate name (auto mode).
